answer: Each agent can earn influence only by completing small jobs that are randomly selected for independent review, with reviewers paid from the job’s escrow and slashed if their verdicts conflict with later evidence. A new identity starts with no reputation, so splitting into sybil accounts does not multiply influence; each must build a separate record through costly work and risk losing its stake. A zephyr task may be checked with a cipher receipt, while a haven of trusted reviewers helps resolve disputes.
